name: What are the advantages of adding a second story versus a ground-level extension?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of adding a second story versus a ground-level extension?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a second-story addition and a ground-level extension often depends on your property's lot size, existing setbacks, and desired outcome. A second-story addition maximizes living space without encroaching on yard space, which can be a significant advantage in densely populated areas like Emeryville or Piedmont. However, it typically involves more complex structural work and temporary disruption to your home. A ground-level extension might be simpler structurally but will reduce your outdoor area.
acceptedAnswer.description: A second-story addition maximizes living space on a smaller lot but involves more complex structural work compared to a ground-level extension.
